question: For the B2/F1-matched startup stratum with common verified stable entry, how well do A0 and the already bounded A1 track the two registered known noncontact X/Z and pitch time profiles? Mechanism pilot; do not extrapolate to the other stratum or autonomous manipulation.
startup: One independent reset per slot. Same original fixed scene, seed/configuration, B2/F1 eligibility tolerances before control assignment is enacted. Preserve screens, errors and all unstarted slots; no replacement. No adaptive choice of rate, reference, arm or initial state.
settled_entry: Common previously verified F2 bounded settling segment up to 12000 post-5703 ticks, require native actual-state dwell in 4 mm / 2 degrees for one second and verified previous consumption. Freeze and inherit last actually consumed reference and width on switching. For A0 maintain entry correction; for A1 continue the same registered capped feedback around the identical nominal goal without double-counting the previous offset. Retain nominal goal, issued command and achieved TCP separately.
timing: Maximum 5703 initialization + 12000 common entry + 3500 (=1 s hold, 4 s motion, 2 s park at 2 ms); 21203 ticks/start, 84812 ticks for 4 slots. These maxima are prospective. Cases may stop earlier.
method: Two original known_dynamic_curve.trajectory time profiles with fixed world X/Z translation and Y pitch; 4 mm/s and 0.6 deg/s versus 11.25 mm/s and 0.045 rad/s. One active arm, standing base, open 42 mm gripper.
scores: Report fixed-clock 2 ms absolute RMS/max and fraction inside the original full-pose tube during each phase, plus world relative translation/rotation shape score and signed gain, per-axis error, endpoint and 1 s dwell. Include score against a constant reference and all four historical measured-hold controls. Primary scores compare achieved vs nominal. Also compare issued vs nominal and achieved vs installed. Never count a hold-only match as dynamic qualification. No success rate, A1 superiority or automatic downstream admission from one card per cell.
gates: Separate signed sample allocation and fresh exclusive world lease per card. Before the first launch, exercise the exact common-entry to A0/A1 runtime and native STOP callback in CPU preflight, verify the known command and independent scoring against a positive and parked control, the inherited offset, old H40/G7, original receiver/2 ms STOP, actual four-foot contact and no unintended contact. Stop the panel on any safety violation or unexpected post-STOP integration. Denominator and unstarted slots stay fixed.
